title: Beer Festival Data API Schema
description: JSON Schema for Cambridge Beer Festival beverage data API responses. DESCRIPTIVE, NOT PRESCRIPTIVE: this feed is produced upstream by the festival and its shape is not a contract the app can hold anyone to. The types below record the widest shapes observed across served festivals, and are deliberately permissive rather than tight. Do not use this schema to justify narrowing the defensive parsing in lib/models/drink.dart, and do not treat it as a validation gate — an unseen variant is expected, not a bug in the parser. See issue #349.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the data was last updated

producers.description: Array of producers (breweries, cideries, meaderies, wineries, etc.)

producer.description: A producer of beverages (brewery, cidery, meadery, winery, etc.)

id.description: Unique identifier for the producer (typically SHA-1 hash)

examples: Ross on Wye Cider & Perry Co.

location.description: Geographic location of the producer (city, region, country)

year_founded.description: Year the producer was established. Quoted or unquoted depending on the festival — summer feeds mix both, winter feeds quote every year — so both forms must be accepted. Parsed via int.tryParse in Producer.fromJson.

notes.description: Additional information about the producer (often includes location and year founded)

products.description: Array of beverages produced by this producer

product.description: A specific beverage (beer, cider, mead, perry, wine, etc.)

id.description: Unique identifier for the product (typically SHA-1 hash)

category.description: Category of beverage. OPEN SET — categories are driven by the data, not by the app, and a festival may introduce one at any time. The app treats this as an opaque string and needs no code change to handle a new value; the examples below are what has been observed, not an exhaustive list.

style.description: Style or variety of the beverage (may be null for some categories like cider)

dispense.description: Method of dispensing the beverage. OPEN SET — keykeg was absent from every summer feed and appeared only once a winter festival served it, so treat the list below as observed values rather than permitted ones.

abv.description: Alcohol by volume percentage. Every festival measured so far serves this as a string, but the numeric form remains accepted — the string-only observation is a property of the current upstream generator, not a guarantee.

notes.description: Tasting notes, ingredients, and other descriptive information
examples: Brewed with Pale Ale malt and First Gold hops...

status_text.description: Availability status of the beverage at the festival. OPEN SET, and the vocabulary is NOT stable across festivals — a winter feed introduced 'Arrived', which no summer feed had used. This is why availability is matched by substring rather than by a closed enum.

bar.description: Location/bar where the beverage is served. A boolean here means 'present at an unspecified bar' and is parsed as no bar name.

is_vegan.description: Whether the drink is suitable for vegans. May be provided as boolean, integer (0/1), or string ('true'/'false'/'yes'/'no'/'1'/'0'). Legacy key 'vegan' may appear in older data and is treated as a fallback.

allergens.description: Allergen information (keys are allergen names, values are truthy indicators)

additionalProperties.description: Truthy value indicates presence of allergen (1, true, non-empty string)
